comment_regular: DX10 bridge note: Oblivion derives the fog-table capability flag from Caps.RasterCaps bits 0x100 (D3DPRASTERCAPS_FOGTABLE) and 0x100000 (D3DPRASTERCAPS_WFOG). The DX10 bridge uses this observed behavior when seeding FOGTABLEMODE defaults, while runtime fog changes are captured through SetRenderState.
